platform: Windows / NTFS / installed WinFsp / installed Sandbox IPC v18

processObservation.method: CIM PID plus creation time bound before terminating the fixture service

checks: Real production task interrupted while Sandbox command held a flushed partial write
No synthetic task status, manifest, task lock or drain declaration
Root-only security mount rejects enumeration, file read and file creation
Native account termination precedes temporary mount, grant revocation and unmount
Dirty flag, epoch, baselines, non-root nodes, owner record, manifest and task lock retained
HTTP interrupted reference creates a fresh session without starting a task
Explicit new task reads current source and reference, edits and publishes through main and candidate Sandbox Runtimes
limitations: Fixed provider and small synthetic fixture; HTTP coverage, not a new browser crash scenario
CIM observation covers two bound identities, not arbitrary descendants
Only known Local roots in the current data directory are recovered for ACL cleanup
Candidate-volume crashes, damaged databases, other data directories and power loss remain outside this proof
No automatic resume of the original dirty view and no POSIX claim
